title: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Grind soaked cashews into a smooth paste.
Melt butter in a pan and sauté the onion until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree, chilli powder and salt; cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in cashew paste and half a cup of water.
Add paneer and garam masala; simmer for 5 minutes.
Finish with cream and serve hot with naan.

title: Masala Dosa
steps: Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Add onion and green chillies; cook until soft.
Add turmeric, salt and mashed potatoes; mix well.
Spread a ladle of batter thinly on a hot tawa.
Drizzle oil and cook until crisp.
Place potato filling in the centre, fold and serve with chutney.

title: Chicken Biryani
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, biryani masala, ginger-garlic paste and salt for 1 hour.
Soak rice for 30 minutes, then boil until 70% cooked.
Fry onions in ghee until brown; keep half aside.
Add tomatoes and marinated chicken; cook for 15 minutes.
Layer rice over chicken, top with fried onions, mint and saffron milk.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat for 20 minutes.

title: Rajma Chawal
steps: Pressure cook rajma with salt for 6 whistles.
Heat oil and add cumin seeds.
Sauté onions until golden, then add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree and rajma masala; cook until oil separates.
Add cooked rajma with its water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve hot over rice.

title: Egg Curry
steps: Peel the eggs and make small slits on them.
Lightly fry the eggs with a pinch of turmeric; set aside.
Sauté onions until brown, then add tomatoes and spices.
Cook until the masala thickens, then add 1 cup water.
Add eggs and simmer for 8 minutes.
Garnish with coriander leaves.

title: Poha
steps: Rinse poha in a strainer and let it soften for 5 minutes.
Roast peanuts in oil and set aside.
Add mustard seeds, curry leaves, onion and potato; cook until potato is soft.
Add turmeric, salt, sugar and the poha; mix gently.
Cover and steam for 2 minutes.
Add peanuts, lemon juice and coriander before serving.

title: Fish Fry
steps: Clean the fish and pat it dry.
Mix ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, turmeric, salt and lemon juice.
Coat the fish with the masala and rest for 20 minutes.
Dust each piece with rice flour.
Shallow fry on medium heat for 4 minutes per side.
Serve with onion rings and lemon wedges.

title: Aloo Paratha
steps: Knead flour with water and salt into a soft dough; rest 15 minutes.
Mix potatoes with chilli, ajwain, amchur, coriander and salt.
Roll a small disc, place filling in the centre and seal it.
Roll gently into a paratha.
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee until golden on both sides.
Serve with curd and pickle.

title: Chole
steps: Pressure cook chickpeas with a tea bag and salt for 5 whistles.
Remove the tea bag.
Sauté onions until brown, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree and chole masala; cook until thick.
Add chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes, mashing a few.
Serve with bhature or rice.

title: Mutton Rogan Josh
steps: Heat mustard oil until it smokes, then lower the heat.
Add cardamom and bay leaves, then the mutton; sear for 10 minutes.
Mix chilli powder in a little water and add to the pan.
Add curd slowly while stirring.
Add fennel, dry ginger and salt with 2 cups water.
Cover and cook on low heat for 60 minutes until tender.

title: Dal Makhani
ingredients: 3/4 cup whole urad dal, soaked overnight
steps: Pressure cook urad dal and rajma with salt for 8 whistles.
Melt butter, add ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute.
Add tomato puree and chilli powder; cook until thick.
Add the cooked dal and mash it a little.
Simmer on low heat for 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in garam masala and cream, then serve with naan.

title: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder and salt for 30 minutes.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken until lightly charred; set aside.
Melt butter and cook the tomato puree for 10 minutes.
Add sugar, salt and a splash of water; simmer until smooth.
Add the chicken and crushed kasuri methi; cook for 5 minutes.
Finish with cream and serve with naan.

title: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach for 2 minutes, then dip in cold water.
Blend spinach with green chillies into a smooth puree.
Heat oil, add cumin, then onion and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato and cook until soft.
Add spinach puree, salt and garam masala; simmer 5 minutes.
Add paneer and cream, cook 2 more minutes and serve.

title: Pav Bhaji
steps: Boil cauliflower and peas until soft.
Melt butter, saute onion and capsicum until soft.
Add tomatoes and cook until mushy.
Add pav bhaji masala, salt and all boiled vegetables.
Mash everything well and simmer for 10 minutes.
Toast pav in butter and serve with bhaji, onion and lemon.

title: Idli
steps: Soak rice, and dal with fenugreek, separately for 6 hours.
Grind both into a smooth batter and mix with salt.
Leave the batter to ferment overnight.
Grease idli moulds and pour in the batter.
Steam for 12 minutes.
Serve hot with sambar and coconut chutney.

title: Upma
steps: Dry roast rava until it smells nutty; set aside.
Heat ghee, add mustard seeds, urad dal and curry leaves.
Add onion, chillies and carrot; cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in water with salt and bring to a boil.
Add rava slowly while stirring to avoid lumps.
Cover and cook on low heat for 3 minutes, then serve.

title: Chicken Tikka
steps: Mix curd, ginger-garlic paste, spices, mustard oil, lemon juice and salt.
Coat chicken, onion and capsicum with the marinade.
Rest in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or bake at 220 °C for 15 to 18 minutes, turning once.
Serve with mint chutney and onion rings.

title: Aloo Gobi
steps: Heat oil and add cumin seeds.
Add onion and cook until golden.
Add tomato, turmeric, coriander powder and salt.
Add potatoes and cauliflower and mix well.
Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes, stirring gently.
Sprinkle garam masala and serve with roti.

title: Khichdi
steps: Wash rice and dal together.
Heat ghee in a pressure cooker, add cumin and hing.
Add rice, dal, turmeric and salt; stir for a minute.
Add water and pressure cook for 4 whistles.
Mash lightly and add more ghee on top.
Serve with curd, papad and pickle.

title: Keema Matar
steps: Heat oil and cook onions until brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute.
Add mince and cook on high heat until it changes colour.
Add tomatoes and all spices; cook until oil separates.
Add peas and half a cup of water; cover and cook 15 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve with pav or roti.

title: Gulab Jamun
steps: Boil sugar, water and cardamom for 5 minutes to make syrup.
Mix milk powder, maida, soda and ghee.
Add milk little by little to make a soft dough.
Shape into smooth balls with no cracks.
Fry on low heat until deep golden brown.
Soak in warm syrup for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Masala Chai
steps: Boil water with ginger, cardamom and cloves for 2 minutes.
Add tea leaves and boil for 1 minute.
Add milk and sugar.
Bring to a boil twice, letting it rise each time.
Strain into cups and serve hot.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients: 100 g chicken or pork bacon, diced
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente; keep a cup of pasta water.
Fry the bacon with garlic until crisp, then remove the garlic.
Whisk eggs, yolk, parmesan and lots of black pepper.
Toss hot pasta with the bacon off the heat.
Stir in the egg mix quickly, adding pasta water until creamy.
Serve at once with more cheese.

title: Margherita Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza base or 250 g pizza dough
steps: Heat the oven to its highest setting, around 250 °C.
Stretch the dough into a thin round.
Spread tomato sauce, leaving a border.
Tear mozzarella over the top and sprinkle oregano and salt.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the crust is golden.
Top with basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Penne Arrabbiata
steps: Boil penne in salted water until al dente.
Warm olive oil and gently fry garlic and chilli flakes.
Add crushed tomatoes and salt; simmer for 12 minutes.
Toss the drained penne in the sauce.
Finish with parsley and serve.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
steps: Cook fettuccine until al dente.
Melt butter and cook the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in parmesan until smooth.
Toss in the pasta, season and serve.

title: Chicken Lasagna
steps: Cook onion and mince until browned, then add tomato sauce and herbs.
Simmer the meat sauce for 15 minutes.
Layer sheets, meat sauce and white sauce in a baking dish.
Repeat to make three layers and top with cheeses.
Bake at 190 °C for 35 minutes.
Rest for 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Saute mushrooms in olive oil until golden; set aside.
Cook onion in butter until soft, then add the rice and stir for 2 minutes.
Add stock one ladle at a time, stirring until each is absorbed.
Keep going for about 20 minutes until the rice is creamy.
Stir in mushrooms, parmesan and a knob of butter.
Season and serve right away.

title: Pesto Pasta
steps: Blend basil, nuts, garlic and parmesan.
Stream in olive oil while blending until smooth.
Cook pasta until al dente; keep some pasta water.
Toss pasta with pesto, loosening with pasta water.
Serve with extra parmesan.

title: Minestrone
steps: Cook onion, carrot and celery in olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add zucchini, tomatoes and stock; simmer 15 minutes.
Add beans and pasta and cook until the pasta is tender.
Season well.
Serve with crusty bread and parmesan.

title: Bruschetta
steps: Toast the bread slices until crisp.
Rub each slice with the cut garlic.
Mix tomatoes, basil, olive oil, vinegar and salt.
Spoon the tomato mix onto the toast.
Serve straight away.

title: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into rounds.
Arrange them on a plate, alternating with basil.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Greek Salad
steps: Put tomatoes, cucumber, onion and capsicum in a bowl.
Add the olives.
Place the feta block on top.
Sprinkle oregano and salt and drizzle olive oil.
Toss gently at the table.

title: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Season and grill the chicken for 6 minutes per side, then slice.
Whisk mayonnaise, mustard, garlic, lemon juice and half the parmesan.
Tear the lettuce into a large bowl.
Toss lettuce with the dressing.
Top with chicken, croutons and remaining parmesan.

title: French Onion Soup
steps: Cook onions in butter on low heat for 35 minutes until deep brown.
Add sugar and flour and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Ladle into oven-proof bowls.
Top with toast and cheese and grill until bubbling.

title: Ratatouille
steps: Saute aubergine in olive oil until golden; set aside.
Cook zucchini and capsicum the same way.
Cook onion and garlic until soft.
Add tomatoes and thyme and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return all vegetables and simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Finish with basil.

title: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Line a tart tin with the pastry and bake blind at 190 °C for 12 minutes.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Whisk eggs, cream, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Scatter bacon and cheese in the pastry case.
Pour over the egg mix.
Bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes until just set.

title: French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, sugar and cinnamon.
Dip each bread slice for a few seconds per side.
Melt butter in a pan on medium heat.
Cook slices until golden on both sides.
Serve with honey or syrup and fruit.

title: Crêpes
ingredients: Nutella or lemon and sugar to serve
steps: Whisk flour, sugar and salt, then add eggs and milk to make a thin batter.
Stir in melted butter and rest for 15 minutes.
Heat a lightly buttered pan.
Pour a small ladle of batter and swirl it thin.
Cook 1 minute per side.
Fill, fold and serve.

title: Spanish Omelette
steps: Gently fry potatoes and onion in olive oil until soft, about 15 minutes.
Drain and mix them with beaten eggs and salt.
Pour into a hot oiled pan and cook on low heat.
Flip using a plate once the base is set.
Cook 3 more minutes and serve warm or cold.

title: Seafood Paella
steps: Cook onion and capsicum in olive oil in a wide pan.
Add tomato and paprika and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in rice, then pour in hot stock with saffron.
Simmer without stirring for 15 minutes.
Press seafood into the rice and cook 8 more minutes.
Rest covered for 5 minutes and serve with lemon.

title: Gazpacho
steps: Roughly chop all the vegetables.
Soak the bread in a little water.
Blend everything with olive oil, vinegar and salt until smooth.
Chill for at least 1 hour.
Serve cold with a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Shepherd’s Pie
steps: Boil potatoes and mash with butter, milk and salt.
Brown the mince with onion and carrot.
Add tomato paste, peas and stock; simmer 15 minutes.
Spread the meat in a baking dish and top with mash.
Rough up the top with a fork.
Bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes until golden.

title: Fish and Chips
steps: Cut potatoes into thick chips and fry at a low heat for 6 minutes; drain.
Whisk flour, baking powder, salt and soda water into a batter.
Dip fish in flour, then in batter.
Fry fish in hot oil for 5 minutes until golden.
Fry the chips again until crisp.
Serve with lemon and tartar sauce.

title: Roast Chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Mix butter with garlic, herbs, salt and pepper.
Rub the butter under and over the skin.
Put the halved lemon inside the chicken.
Roast for 70 to 80 minutes until the juices run clear.
Rest for 10 minutes before carving.

title: Creamy Mashed Potatoes
steps: Peel and cube the potatoes.
Boil in salted water until very soft, about 15 minutes.
Drain and let them steam dry for 2 minutes.
Mash with butter and warm milk.
Season and top with chives.

title: Mac and Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni until just tender.
Melt butter, stir in flour and cook 1 minute.
Whisk in milk and cook until thick.
Stir in cheese and mustard until smooth.
Mix with macaroni, top with breadcrumbs.
Bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter one side of each slice.
Place cheese (and tomato) between unbuttered sides.
Cook in a pan on medium heat for 3 minutes.
Flip and cook until golden and melted.
Cut in half and serve hot.

title: Garlic Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Mix butter, garlic, parsley and salt.
Slice the baguette and spread the butter generously.
Add cheese if you like.
Bake for 10 minutes until crisp and golden.

title: Apple Crumble
steps: Toss apples with sugar and cinnamon in a baking dish.
Rub flour and butter together until it looks like breadcrumbs.
Stir in brown sugar and oats.
Scatter the crumble over the apples.
Bake at 180 °C for 35 minutes until golden.
Serve warm with custard or ice cream.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
steps: Toss chicken with 1 tbsp soy sauce and cornflour.
Mix the remaining soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 2 tbsp water.
Fry chillies and Sichuan pepper in hot oil for 20 seconds.
Add chicken and stir-fry until cooked.
Add ginger-garlic and spring onion, then pour in the sauce.
Toss in peanuts and serve with rice.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil until smoking and add garlic.
Add carrot and beans; stir-fry 2 minutes on high heat.
Add cabbage and the white part of spring onions.
Tip in the rice and toss well.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Finish with spring onion greens.

title: Sweet and Sour Chicken
steps: Coat chicken in egg and cornflour, then deep-fry until crisp.
Mix ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce and 1/2 cup water.
Stir-fry onion and capsicum for 2 minutes.
Add pineapple and the sauce; bring to a boil.
Thicken with 1 tsp cornflour in water.
Toss in the chicken and serve right away.

title: Mapo Tofu
steps: Blanch tofu in salted water for 2 minutes and drain.
Fry the mince until crisp.
Add chilli bean paste, garlic and ginger; fry until red oil forms.
Pour in stock and soy sauce, then slide in the tofu.
Simmer 5 minutes and thicken with cornflour slurry.
Top with Sichuan pepper and spring onions.

title: Vegetable Spring Rolls
steps: Stir-fry garlic and vegetables on high heat for 3 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and let it cool.
Place filling on a sheet, fold the sides and roll tightly.
Seal the edge with cornflour paste.
Deep-fry until golden and crisp.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

title: Hot and Sour Soup
steps: Bring stock to a boil.
Add mushrooms, carrot and tofu; simmer 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, white pepper and chilli sauce.
Stir in cornflour mixed with water until slightly thick.
Taste and adjust the sour and spice.
Serve topped with spring onions.

title: Chilli Chicken
steps: Coat chicken with egg, cornflour, ginger-garlic paste and salt.
Deep-fry until crisp and golden.
Stir-fry onion, capsicum and green chillies on high heat.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce and vinegar.
Toss in the chicken until coated.
Serve dry, or add a little cornflour slurry for gravy.

title: Gobi Manchurian
steps: Blanch cauliflower for 3 minutes and drain.
Coat in a thick batter of maida, cornflour, salt and water.
Deep-fry until crisp.
Stir-fry ginger, garlic, chillies and spring onion.
Add soy sauce, ketchup and chilli sauce.
Toss the fried florets in the sauce and serve hot.

title: Hakka Noodles
steps: Boil noodles until just done, rinse in cold water and toss with oil.
Heat oil until very hot and add garlic.
Add vegetables and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add noodles with soy sauce, vinegar and chilli sauce.
Toss well on high heat.
Finish with spring onion greens.

title: Chicken Teriyaki
steps: Mix soy sauce, mirin, honey and ginger.
Pan-fry chicken skin-side down until crisp, about 7 minutes.
Flip and cook 5 more minutes.
Pour in the sauce and simmer until glossy.
Slice and spoon the glaze over.
Top with sesame and spring onion; serve with rice.

title: Miso Soup
steps: Soak kombu in water for 20 minutes, then heat until just simmering and remove it.
Soak wakame in water for 5 minutes and drain.
Add tofu to the warm stock.
Dissolve miso in a ladle of stock and stir it back in. Do not boil.
Add wakame and spring onions and serve.

title: Vegetable Sushi Rolls
steps: Cook rice and mix in vinegar, sugar and salt; let it cool.
Place nori on a bamboo mat and spread a thin layer of rice.
Lay cucumber, carrot and avocado along one edge.
Roll tightly using the mat.
Slice with a wet knife into 8 pieces.
Serve with soy sauce and ginger.

title: Chicken Katsu
steps: Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Coat in flour, then egg, then panko.
Shallow fry 4 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper and rest 2 minutes.
Slice into strips.
Serve with cabbage, rice and tonkatsu sauce.

title: Pad Thai
steps: Soak noodles in warm water for 20 minutes and drain.
Mix tamarind, fish sauce and sugar.
Stir-fry prawns until pink, push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add noodles and sauce and toss until coated.
Add bean sprouts and spring onions.
Serve with peanuts and lime.

title: Thai Green Curry
steps: Fry curry paste in a little coconut cream until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk.
Add vegetables and simmer 10 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and sugar.
Stir in basil and serve with rice.

title: Tom Yum Soup
steps: Bruise lemongrass and add to stock with galangal and lime leaves.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and chillies.
Add prawns and cook until pink.
Turn off the heat and add fish sauce and lime juice.
Garnish with coriander.

title: Mango Sticky Rice
steps: Soak rice for at least 4 hours, then steam for 25 minutes.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt.
Pour two-thirds over the hot rice and rest 15 minutes.
Slice the mangoes.
Plate rice with mango and drizzle the remaining coconut milk.
Sprinkle sesame seeds.

title: Chicken Tacos
steps: Season chicken with spices, salt and lime juice.
Cook in a hot pan for 6 to 8 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with chicken, lettuce, tomato and onion.
Top with sour cream and a squeeze of lime.

title: Guacamole
steps: Halve the avocados and scoop into a bowl.
Mash roughly with a fork.
Mix in onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Add lime juice and salt to taste.
Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Bean and Cheese Burrito
steps: Warm beans with cumin and salt, mashing lightly.
Warm tortillas so they fold easily.
Layer rice, beans, corn, salsa and cheese in the centre.
Fold the sides in and roll up tightly.
Toast seam-side down in a pan until golden.
Serve with sour cream.

title: Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Saute capsicum and onion for 3 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese on half of each tortilla.
Add vegetables and chilli flakes, then fold.
Cook in butter 2 minutes per side until melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

title: Loaded Nachos
ingredients: 1 cup cheese sauce or grated cheese
steps: Spread chips on a baking tray.
Top with beans and cheese.
Bake at 200 °C for 6 minutes until melted.
Add tomato, onion and jalapeños.
Finish with sour cream and guacamole.

title: Churros
ingredients: 1/3 cup sugar mixed with 1 tsp cinnamon
steps: Boil water, sugar, salt and oil.
Stir in flour off the heat to make a smooth dough.
Pipe strips through a star nozzle into hot oil.
Fry until golden and drain.
Roll in cinnamon sugar.
Serve with warm chocolate sauce.

title: Hummus
steps: Blend chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon juice and cumin.
Add ice water slowly while blending until very smooth.
Season with salt.
Spread in a bowl with a swirl.
Drizzle olive oil and dust with paprika.
Serve with pita.

title: Falafel
steps: Drain chickpeas well; do not cook them.
Pulse with onion, garlic, herbs and spices until coarse.
Add baking soda and salt and chill for 30 minutes.
Shape into small balls or patties.
Fry until deep golden.
Serve in pita with hummus and salad.

title: Chicken Shawarma
steps: Marinate chicken with curd, lemon, spices and garlic for 2 hours.
Cook in a hot pan or grill until charred.
Rest, then slice thinly.
Warm the pita.
Fill with chicken, garlic sauce, pickles and salad.
Roll up and toast for a minute.

title: Shakshuka
steps: Cook onion and capsicum in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook until the whites set.
Top with feta and parsley and serve with bread.

title: Tabbouleh
steps: Soak bulgur in hot water for 10 minutes and squeeze dry.
Mix with parsley, mint, tomatoes and spring onions.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil and salt.
Rest 10 minutes and serve.

title: Bibimbap
steps: Saute each vegetable separately with a pinch of salt.
Fry the eggs sunny side up.
Put warm rice in bowls.
Arrange the vegetables on top in sections.
Add the egg, gochujang and sesame oil.
Mix everything at the table.

title: Kimchi Fried Rice
steps: Fry the kimchi in oil for 3 minutes.
Add gochujang and kimchi juice.
Add rice and soy sauce and toss well.
Fry eggs separately.
Drizzle sesame oil over the rice.
Top with egg and spring onion.

title: Tteokbokki
steps: Soak rice cakes in warm water for 10 minutes.
Bring water, gochujang, chilli flakes, sugar and soy sauce to a boil.
Add rice cakes and simmer 10 minutes, stirring.
Cook until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Add spring onions and sesame seeds.

title: Fluffy Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk milk, egg and butter separately.
Combine gently; a few lumps are fine.
Pour small rounds onto a hot greased pan.
Flip when bubbles form and cook 1 more minute.
Serve stacked with syrup.

title: Fudgy Brownies
steps: Melt chocolate and butter together.
Whisk in sugar, then the eggs.
Fold in flour, cocoa and salt.
Add walnuts and pour into a lined tin.
Bake at 175 °C for 25 minutes.
Cool fully before cutting.

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Boil spaghetti in well-salted water.
Warm olive oil with garlic on low heat until pale golden.
Add chilli flakes.
Toss in the spaghetti with a splash of pasta water.
Finish with parsley and serve.

title: Tiramisu
steps: Beat yolks with sugar until pale, then fold in mascarpone.
Whip whites to soft peaks and fold in gently.
Dip ladyfingers quickly in coffee.
Layer biscuits and cream in a dish, twice.
Chill for at least 4 hours.
Dust with cocoa before serving.
